verdict.rationale: The evidence lists RustDesk's session features: remote view and control, file transfer and clipboard file copy. It never documents a way to scope or restrict a connected peer to view-only, control, clipboard or file access. Server Pro's "per-user and device-group access control" governs who may connect, not what a session may do, so it is only adjacent. The vague "90 options" claim does not establish this capability.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
